findings.evidence: Lines 413-418: proof is `have h : ⇑(hf.toIsometryGroupOfIsUnitDet hdet : M ≃ₗ[R] M) = ⇑f := funext …; exact h ▸ (…).bijective` — `hf` enters only through the group element. Mathlib already has `LinearMap.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:327) and `LinearMap.coe_equivOfIsUnitDet` (:560) for the hypothesis-free statement.
findings.fix: Drop `hf` and state it outside the `IsIsometry` namespace (e.g. `theorem LinearMap.bijective_of_isUnit_det (hdet : IsUnit (LinearMap.det f)) : Function.Bijective f`, proved by `LinearMap.coe_equivOfIsUnitDet hdet ▸ (LinearMap.equivOfIsUnitDet hdet).bijective` or via Mathlib's `LinearMap.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det`), and have `IsIsometry.bijective` call it.
findings.issue: `IsIsometry.bijective_of_isUnit_det (hf : IsIsometry B f) (hdet : IsUnit (det f)) : Function.Bijective f` does not use `hf` mathematically — its own docstring states "An endomorphism of a finite free module with unit determinant is bijective", with no isometry involved; `hf` only serves to route the proof through `toIsometryGroupOfIsUnitDet`. The exported interface is therefore inapplicable to any endomorphism that is not an isometry of some form, and its name/namespace misdescribe it.

findings.evidence: grep for `IsIsometry` in TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/InvariantForm.lean returns only the definition (line 142), the docstring (line 78), and in-file proof steps (lines 150-151, 161-165, 174, 187, 193, 283); no exported lemma relates `IsInvariantForm` to `BilinForm.IsIsometry`.
findings.fix: Add the characteristic bridge in both directions, e.g. `theorem IsInvariantForm.isIsometry (hB : IsInvariantForm ρ B) (g : G) : BilinForm.IsIsometry B (ρ g)` and `theorem isInvariantForm_iff_isIsometry : IsInvariantForm ρ B ↔ ∀ g, BilinForm.IsIsometry B (ρ g)`.
findings.issue: `IsInvariantForm ρ B` is redefined as `∀ g, BilinForm.IsIsometry B (ρ g)`, and the module docstring (line 77-79) advertises that "the invariant forms of a representation and the isometry group of a form are the same notion read two ways" — but no lemma states that. The body is not exposed (plain `public section` at line 125; `isInvariantForm_iff` is no longer `Iff.rfl` but a proved iff into the pointwise form), so a consumer holding `IsInvariantForm ρ B` cannot obtain `BilinForm.IsIsometry B (ρ g)` and apply the new bilinear-form API (`IsIsometry.restrict`, `map_orthogonal`, `baseChange`, `det_sq_eq_one`) to `ρ g` without re-deriving it through `isInvariantForm_iff` and `isIsometry_iff`.

summary: Prior findings are addressed, but `IsIsometry.bijective_of_isUnit_det` exports a general linear-algebra fact under a spurious `IsIsometry` hypothesis and namespace, and the redefinition of `IsInvariantForm` in terms of `IsIsometry` ships no bridge lemma, so downstream consumers cannot cross between the two notions the docstring claims are identified.
